dwarf_read: pyelftools; DW_TAG_subprogram matched on DW_AT_name / DW_AT_linkage_name; each DW_TAG_formal_parameter's DW_AT_type followed through typedef / const / volatile / pointer to the DIE carrying DW_AT_byte_size and DW_AT_encoding; the return type from the subprogram's DW_AT_type, or for go from the formal parameter flagged DW_AT_variable_parameter

memory.bound: ABORT_MEMORY_T101B at 4 GB on the parent, resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) after every store file

population.a_probe_is_accepted_when: its store record carries an `anchor` side and no `refused` field

row_fields.declared_spelling: the manifest's own declaration (meta lhs_type / rhs_type / result_type)
row_fields.dwarf_byte_size: DW_AT_byte_size on the terminal DIE of the chain
row_fields.dwarf_encoding: DW_AT_encoding on the terminal DIE, by its DW_ATE_ name; null when absent
row_fields.dwarf_encoding_absent_on_the_type: true when the terminal DIE carries no DW_AT_encoding
row_fields.dwarf_spelling: the chain rendered C-style (typedef by its own name, modifiers prefixed)
row_fields.dwarf_structure_members: when the terminal DIE is a structure: its members' own chains, one hop
row_fields.dwarf_type_chain: every DIE the walk passed, as read

source_regeneration: each probe's source is re-rendered from its store `meta` by probe_gen.emit_<lang>, and compared byte for byte with the manifest's stored `source`; a mismatch is refused by name (render_differs_from_manifest) and never compiled
spelling_ban: no operator token appears in any key, grouping, pairing or row structure; rows are keyed by store file and probe number, and the probe operator is read only to hand it to probe_gen's template
